name: Alfasem

attributes.attribute: looked at the Grail before his soul was pure
wounded in his loins until the quest was done

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Alfasem is one of the Blemished Kings of Arthurian legend. He tried to look at the Grail before his soul was pure. The glance cost him a wound in his loins, and he stayed hurt until the Grail quest was done.

okr.objective: Record Alfasem, a wounded Grail king.
key_results: Show his rash glance and its cost.
